protocol.selection: Three development photos fixed before crop inference. Bounds chosen from visible source images. Whole-image results had already been observed in paired evaluation; this is an exploratory crop pilot, not a holdout.
protocol.policy: Actual rules-controller whole-photo run, then explicit user-region selection and actual region inference; finish partial if another photo is requested. Do not adjust boxes after observing crop predictions.

region_inspection.diagnostic_note: Heuristic pixel diagnostics, not calibrated quality or dog detection.

comparison.summary: The leading class changes across recorded views. The assessment remains inconclusive.
blockers: Recorded rankings disagree on the leading class, including any region comparisons.
Current results have quality concerns, weak scores, or an unresolved published label.
comparison.policy_note: Score ≥ 0.5 and margin ≥ 0.15 are conservative, uncalibrated reporting heuristics. They do not detect dogs.
comparison.aggregation: Order by distinct-photo leading votes, then top-five appearances, then summed best ranks. Never average raw scores. Crops share their parent photo's vote.

report.change: The leading class changes across recorded views. The assessment remains inconclusive.
limitations: Likely visual breed matches only. Scores are uncalibrated model outputs, not genetic ancestry percentages.
Candidates are alternative classifications across 120 known classes. This model cannot reliably reject non-dogs or unfamiliar breeds.
The text-only controller cannot see coat, ears, body shape, or other visual features. It uses numerical tool observations.
report.uncertainty: Breed identity and dog presence remain unverified by independent evidence.
